# 2 Baruch Chapter 46 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 46:1 — departure formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "After-a-little-while I-shall-depart" |
| LOGOS | "In a little while I shall depart" |
| PNEUMA | "Very soon I am going to leave" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac phrase conveys temporal imminence in measured prose; PNEUMA's colloquial 'going to leave' loses the formal register of the farewell speech.

---

## 46:5 — Moses as 'great messenger'

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "who-was-the-great-messenger" |
| LOGOS | "who was the great messenger" |
| PNEUMA | omits the title entirely |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The title 'great messenger' (Syriac: izggada raba) is a technical honorific for Moses attested in Syriac tradition and should be preserved.

---

## 46:7 — location formula at Mamre

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "to-the-oak-tree that-was-at-Mamre" |
| LOGOS | "to the oak tree that was at Mamre" |
| PNEUMA | "to the oak tree at Mamre" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS for its balance between literal accuracy and readable English prose.

---
